resources.string: Read-only can open, scroll, read and summarize. It blocks sending, posting, commenting, liking, following, adding friends, deleting and submitting. Confirm each write asks you first. Normal does not add these limits.
Turn off wireless debugging when idle
Mika can turn wireless debugging back on when the next task starts, so this is on by default. It waits about a minute after the last task.

On a normal phone Mika cannot turn wireless debugging back on by itself. This stays off unless you turn it on. If you turn it on, you will need to open Wireless debugging yourself before the next task, unless Mika already has permission to change system settings.
